about: What some documents must contain, by law or policy, checked by tests on the shipped documents and as warnings on a clinic's own versions. Each element is found by wording: any (one phrase), all (every phrase), signature (a signature block) or forbid (text that must not appear). Phrases are matched without regard to case.

elements.name: What information may be used or disclosed
Who may disclose it
Who may receive it
The purpose of each use or disclosure
An expiration date or event
Signature and date
A representative's authority, when one signs
The right to revoke in writing, its exceptions, and how
Treatment, payment, enrollment or eligibility don't depend on signing
Information disclosed may be disclosed again and lose its protection
The patient gets a copy
